verdict.rationale: Notion positions itself as "one system of record" with connections that "sync your data", and documents a GitHub sync integration. A REST API, webhooks and personal access tokens also let an engineer build custom syncs from other tools into a Notion database. However, the evidence shows no out-of-the-box aggregation of assigned tasks from multiple project management tools (e.g., Jira, Linear, Asana) into a single assignee-filtered view. Missing for 10: documented native sync of tasks from multiple PM tools, an assignee-based unified task view across sources, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
